name: Dynamic Badges
description: Create badges via shields.io/endpoint for your README.md which may change with every commit.

auth.description: Your secret with the gist scope

gistID.description: The ID of the gist to use

filename.description: The *.json or *.svg filename of the badge data

label.description: The left text of the badge

message.description: The right text of the badge

host.description: The base URL of the gist API

forceUpdate.description: If set to true, the gist will be updated even if the content did not change

labelColor.description: The left color of the badge

color.description: The right color of the badge

isError.description: The color will be red and cannot be overridden

logoSvg.description: An svg-string to be used as logo

logoWidth.description: The space allocated for the logo

cacheSeconds.description: The cache lifetime in seconds (must be greater than 300)

valColorRange.description: A numerical value used to define the message color. Usually this should be between maxColorRange and minColorRange. This is required if you want to use the colo

maxColorRange.description: If valColorRange assumes this value, the badge will be green. This is required if you want to use the color range feature.

minColorRange.description: If valColorRange assumes this value, the badge will be red. This is required if you want to use the color range feature.

invertColorRange.description: If the range should be inverted, causing a smaller value to have green color. Defaults to false.

colorRangeSaturation.description: Saturation used by the color range feature. Defaults to 100.

colorRangeLightness.description: Lightness used by the color range feature. Defaults to 40.
